title: FieldValueMap
description: Maps field values based on a lookup table, allowing specific source values to be translated to different target values.

ApplyTo.description: A list of Work Item Types that this Field Map will apply to. Use "*" to apply it to all Work Item Types. A field map with an empty list applies to no Work Item Types and never runs.

defaultValue.description: Gets or sets the default value to use when no mapping is found for the source field value.

Enabled.description: Not used: every configured field map runs for the work item types in `ApplyTo`. To turn a field map off, remove it from `FieldMaps`.

sourceField.description: Gets or sets the name of the source field to read values from during migration.

targetField.description: Gets or sets the name of the target field to write mapped values to during migration.

valueMapping.description: Gets or sets the dictionary that maps source field values to target field values. Key is the source value, value is the target value.
